notes: Three distributive ἕν tokens are left unrepresented; a reference comparison will report them as disagreements.
τὴν γῆν τὴν καλήν: the first article takes the ASV's *the* even though the ASV reorders *good* in front of *ground*, and the second attributive article is unrepresented under rule 23.
ἀναβαίνοντα keeps *up* inside its own unit under rule 106, no preposition standing to answer to it; *brought forth* likewise stays whole on ἔφερεν.
Variant v013 is underdetermined over the ἕν/ἐν readings of the numeral series; the projection's base is aligned as given without a new textual decision (rule 12).
